role: The block half of the three scattered features: DesertPyramid, JunglePyramid and SwampHut addComponentParts (rooms, TNT trap, chests with the temple loot tables, the jungle's randomized cobblestone shell, dispenser traps, tripwire and redstone wiring, the swamp hut's witch), plus Feature.func_74935_a's ground-level settle.

structs.name: TB_* enum
structs.java: the Blocks ids the temple pieces write

gpu: line 129-132, function temple_chest: loot_book_build and loot_book_free around each chest (loot.h says the book is a heap-held stack that must be released: allocation during population)
line 84, function top_solid_or_liquid: strcmp on the material name per column cell
line 76, function top_solid_or_liquid: world_load_chunk may load or generate a chunk from inside a population step
line 115, function feature_ground_level: mutates the shared piece (hpos and bounding box) the first step that covers it, so later steps depend on step order, as in Java
notes: Registered as the Temple type's piece_fn in populate.c. The desert pyramid never calls func_74935_a (its base stays at y 60). Redstone, tripwire and dispenser block callbacks live in blockcb.c; world.conf keeps redstone power off. The Java field names DesertPyramid.field_74940_h and JunglePyramid.field_7494x were matched by grep; SwampHut.hasWitch was matched too.
